_comment: Milestones and tasks created by tools/new-port.sh. Titles match skills/port-playbook/milestones.md. Each task depends on the previous task of its milestone; the first task of a milestone depends on the previous milestone's gate.

milestones.title: M0 Setup
milestones.description: Host tools, workspace, learner profile, safety briefing. Risk: green.

tasks.title: Check host tools
ac: tools/check-host.sh reports no blocking item for M0-M3

tasks.title: Create learner profile
ac: learner section of port.yaml filled (level, depth, language, experience)

tasks.title: Safety briefing
ac: Risk colors, gates, soft/hard brick explained
User confirmed personal data is backed up or not needed
Accepted irreversible costs recorded in learner.accepted_costs

tasks.title: GATE M0: ready to investigate the device
ac: Kickoff lesson given (three pillars, journey map)

milestones.title: M1 Reconnaissance
milestones.description: Read-only investigation of the device over adb. Risk: green.

tasks.title: Collect Android properties and hardware info
ac: Unreadable items listed with the reason

tasks.title: Identify the SoC, board and peripheral chips
ac: SoC, arch, RAM, storage identified with sources
Display, touch, WiFi/BT, modem, PMIC/charger listed (or unknown with a plan)

tasks.title: Map the partition table
ac: dossier/partitions.md lists every partition with size and class A/B/C/D

tasks.title: Identify the boot image format
ac: Header version, page size, offsets, DTB placement known or sourced from pmaports

tasks.title: Check bootloader and secure-boot state
ac: Lock state, verified boot state, OEM unlock support, warranty/KNOX bits recorded

tasks.title: Root-enhanced recon (optional)
ac: Done with root reads, or marked N/A (device not rooted)

tasks.title: Write device dossier summary
ac: dossier/device.md written with a source for every fact

tasks.title: GATE M1: we know the device
ac: SoC, arch, partition map, flash mode, boot format known with sources

milestones.title: M2 Prior art
milestones.description: Find existing Linux work, choose the kernel and boot path. Risk: green.

tasks.title: Search pmaports for the device and SoC
ac: Device, kernel and firmware packages found or confirmed absent
Sibling devices on the same SoC listed

tasks.title: Search the postmarketOS wiki
ac: Device and SoC pages summarised with links

tasks.title: Search mainline Linux and SoC forks
ac: DTS for the board/SoC located or confirmed absent
SoC community forks listed with activity dates

tasks.title: Check second-stage bootloader support
ac: lk2nd/U-Boot support for SoC and device checked

tasks.title: Search downstream sources (LineageOS, vendor)
ac: Device/kernel trees and blob repos listed

tasks.title: Feasibility verdict and kernel path decision
ac: Decision recorded (kernel repo + ref + config + DTB, boot path)

tasks.title: GATE M2: go or no-go
ac: Scenario and confidence explained to the user
User said go (or chose to stop)

milestones.title: M3 Unbrick kit
milestones.description: Prove we can always return to stock before changing anything. Risk: green/yellow.

tasks.title: Locate and download stock firmware
ac: Stock firmware matching the build fingerprint (or newer) in backups/stock with sha256

tasks.title: Install and test the flash tool
ac: A read-only command (getvar / print-pit / printgpt) works against the device

tasks.title: Test every boot mode entry
ac: Bootloader/download, recovery and force-power-off combos tested by the user

tasks.title: Document the emergency recovery procedure
ac: dossier/unbrick.md covers soft brick, bootloop, stock reflash, EDL/BROM

milestones.title: M4 Unlock
milestones.description: Unlock the bootloader with informed consent. Risk: orange (wipes data).

tasks.title: Research the unlock procedure for this device
ac: dossier/unlock.md with procedure, irreversible effects, two sources

tasks.title: Pre-unlock checklist
ac: Plan file written by flash-guardian with all checks green

tasks.title: Unlock the bootloader
ac: Executed from the approved plan, log saved

tasks.title: Verify unlocked state and Android still boots
ac: Unlocked state shown by the bootloader

milestones.title: M5 Backup
milestones.description: Dump and verify every partition we could ever need. Risk: green/yellow.

tasks.title: Choose the backup method
ac: Method chosen (root dd / temporary recovery / vendor read tool) and recorded

tasks.title: Dump all partitions except userdata and system
ac: backups/<name>.img for every partition except userdata/system/super

tasks.title: Verify backups and store a copy off the machine
Set the writable partitions allowlist
ac: safety.writable_partitions set with the user's agreement
Every listed partition has a verified backup

tasks.title: GATE M5: safety net in place

milestones.title: M6 Boot path
milestones.description: A repeatable way to load our own kernel without touching the bootloader chain. Risk: yellow/orange.

tasks.title: Decide whether a second-stage bootloader is needed
ac: experiment_partition set if there is no RAM boot

tasks.title: Round-trip test with the stock boot image
ac: Stock boot image booted from RAM, or flashed back to its own partition, and Android boots

tasks.title: Install or temporarily boot the second stage
ac: lk2nd/U-Boot running from RAM or from the experiment partition via an approved plan
Or marked N/A per the decision

tasks.title: Verify the second stage offers fastboot and boots extlinux
ac: Android still reachable through the escape route

tasks.title: GATE M6: we can load our own kernel

milestones.title: M7 First light
milestones.description: Our kernel prints its boot log on the phone screen, from RAM. Risk: yellow.

tasks.title: Prepare the kernel source and config
Boot it temporarily
ac: Photo of the screen saved in journal/photos

tasks.title: Analyse the result
ac: Kernel log visible on screen, or a diagnosis with the next experiment

tasks.title: GATE M7: first light
ac: Photo shows the kernel log and the init banner

milestones.title: M8 Rescue shell
milestones.description: A RAM-only Buildroot system with USB networking and ssh. Risk: yellow.

tasks.title: Build the rescue initramfs defconfig
ac: <id>_rescue_defconfig builds with dropbear, unudhcpd and the gadget script

tasks.title: Boot rescue and connect over USB networking
Linux hardware inventory
ac: Working/failing devices listed with the reasons

tasks.title: Map Android partitions to Linux block devices
ac: dossier/partitions-linux.md maps mmcblk0pN to names and classes

milestones.title: M9 Persistent Buildroot
milestones.description: A real Buildroot system on flash, in buildroot-android style. Risk: orange.

tasks.title: Fork or clone buildroot-android and add the board
ac: ports/<id>/buildroot-android on branch port/<id> with board/<id> and configs

tasks.title: Choose rootfs placement and boot flow
Flash plan and first persistent flash
Boot, ssh in, check reflash cycle
GATE M9: Buildroot lives on the phone

milestones.title: M10 Hardware
milestones.description: Peripherals the user cares about, one child task each. Risk: orange.

tasks.title: Prioritise peripherals with the user
ac: Child tasks created per peripheral with ACs

tasks.title: Write the init-scripts inventory for Nerves
ac: dossier/init-inventory.md lists every script, daemon, blob and config

tasks.title: GATE M10: hardware enabled
ac: Chosen peripherals work or are documented as deferred

milestones.title: M11 Nerves
milestones.description: Nerves with A/B updates inside the Android partitions. Risk: orange.

tasks.title: Design the A/B layout inside Android partitions
Boot flow for slot switching
ac: Slot selection and revert designed and tested on file images

tasks.title: Port init scripts to Elixir
ac: Each init-inventory row has an Elixir replacement or a task

tasks.title: Test mix upload, revert and factory reset
ac: mix upload boots the other slot
Revert returns to the previous slot

tasks.title: Write device documentation
ac: docs/<id>.md in buildroot-android: what works, how to flash, partitions

tasks.title: Prepare a PR to buildroot-android
ac: Branch ready; the user decided whether to open the PR

tasks.title: Compile the learner journal
ac: journal/README.md tells the story with links to all lessons
